items.question: Which yoni is said to cause the birth of Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva?
premises: The yoni causes birth of the triad.
Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva are named together.
items.inference: The verse identifies a birth-causing yoni associated with Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva.
uncertainties: The exact referent of yoni is not specified beyond its birth-causing role.
The fused compound and ca are analyzed as one token.
items.plain_english: And the yoni that causes the birth of Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva.
